author_clarifications: Keep element_type, retire role and use role information to enrich element_type.
Do not add missing cables; change only the conditional cable in product.retail.connect_office to always supplied.
decisions: Use a descriptive element_type string retaining any existing classification followed by the role text. Schema retains optional legacy role for pending records and old snapshots.
Connect My Office supplies one fixed 2 m cable, defined as a separate base part. Workstation and network-card cable contents are unchanged.
Remove optional network hardware from the fixed Budget HDD package along with separately supplied Abacus.
Keep original product IDs for CP/M Mouse Learning and desktop AIONix²; add AIONix and Server variants.
Preserve AIONix cartridge-exchange service semantics and qualification gates; separate technical OS editions are not invented.
remaining_device_conditions: Five OEM assembly inclusion conditions remain in device BOMs; they require manufacturing/sourcing decisions, rather than commercial offering splits.

superseded_quantity_discussion.title: Resolve the two conditional hardware quantities
superseded_quantity_discussion.reason: Your diskette defaults are implemented in the two software-edition proposals, including their paired base-part definitions. The remaining quantities describe hardware, not installation media. A site survey determines network cable quantities and CP/M application qualification determines whether a hardware module is needed. The diskette default of one does not establish either hardware quantity. Please specify whether to retain these variable quantities or define a standard per-installation package.

findings.description: Network cables have a null quantity because site survey determines counts and lengths; propose a fixed package only if its scope is specified.
The CP/M-80 module is supplied only where application qualification requires it. Confirm one module per qualifying system, or retain a variable project quantity.
